source_integrity.summary: Re-fetched exact pending blob and EN/PT research Git blobs on main; recorded 3 canonical blob SHAs. Approved snapshot retains complete producer metadata.

source_vintage_and_cutoff.summary: Confirmed 2026 Russell announced transaction still conditional on Q1 2027 closing; 10 Nov 2026 Forbes timestamp; 2020 and 2023 B Capital primary fundraising dates; 2012 Facebook IPO and Meta 2025 10-K.

factual_methodology.summary: Independent QA sampled core primary and contemporary statements: Russell acquisition and 416bn AUM; B Capital >12bn AUM; 2020 Fund II final 820m vs interim 410m; 2023 Growth III 2.1bn; Ascent 254m/500m; Meta voting structure; 2026 Forbes net worth; Moneycontrol corroborates Byju's/Mojocare exposure. Distinctions between ownership, client mandates, gross raised commitments, unconfirmed deal price and realized LP returns preserved.

evidence_traceability.summary: EN/PT each has 28 aligned numbered source URLs across 17 hosts or fewer; sampled and cross-checked core primary sources via public pages and contemporaneous Reuters/Bloomberg/Forbes/TechCrunch. Every individual citation not independently re-audited against full paywalled source text.

research_depth.summary: 18 narrative sections per language with detailed history, founder equity, corporate governance, VC LP/GP economics, funding vintages, geography, two documented negative cases, Russell acquisition and conditional outcomes. No generic epistemic afterword.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: 2 numerically identical sourced bar charts in both languages: [360,820] final fund close commitments and [254,500] Ascent commitments; 2 tables each, 2 causal flows, one mindmap, one geographic map. Charts compare same units, categories and financial status; not investment returns.

bilingual_equivalence.summary: Both editions have 18 sections, 28 identically numbered URLs, two matching chart numerical series, aligned statements on Meta, B Capital, Byju's, Mojocare and prospective Russell acquisition.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Long-form opening leads with analytical fact and mechanism; no editorial metadescriptions or execution instructions in report; numbered source references appear at end; no staged public bundle or unsupported publication claim.

counterfactual_review.summary: Tests Meta wealth against retained rights and network effects, distinguishes founder luck from repeated net VC returns, considers institutional acquisition alternatives and portfolio failures; no invented personal tax savings or fund-level write-offs.

pipeline_validation.summary: Read effective repository depth/visual/pipeline checks and applied their content/taxonomy/numeric parity conditions against exact staged sources. Full Node npm run validate cannot run in sandbox because direct GitHub checkout network resolution is unavailable; public publisher/CI must execute build validation.

contrary_evidence: Personal Meta-linked net worth does not establish B Capital fund net returns; comprehensive audited fund vintage DPI/TVPI series not public.
Byju's and Mojocare evidence contradicts infallible selection/due diligence claims; specific B Capital realized losses not independently disclosed.
Russell transaction announced but pending; $416bn refers to client assets, not purchase price or manager net worth.
Possible fund manager advantages from BCG and multinational access are not proof of superior exit performance.
limitations: Review is assistant-led evidence sampling, not a separate human audit; full line-by-line verification of all 28 cited sources was not possible.
No complete public fund-level net DPI, TVPI, carried-interest or realized write-off data; no claim of B Capital outperformance.
Forbes wealth is a real-time estimate tied to market price; exact Meta holdings and personal tax filings are not public.
Bloomberg Russell ~$2.8bn deal price came from an unnamed source and is not officially confirmed.
Full npm validation and production deploy checks must be performed by publisher/CI; this approval does not claim site deployment.
notes: QA review performed on a separate subsequent user turn after producer draft; shortcomings discovered and revised before approval, particularly interim vs final Fund II close and chart budget. Source sampling limitations explicit; SHA-bound to full corrected bilingual text. No direct edits of reports/ or public indexes.
